release_use_policy: The EBU permits this package as an R&D tool and states that downloading agrees not to use the material commercially other than as an R&D tool. It is retained only for development transfer research. It is not the sealed release-held-out corpus, must not be shipped with Reklawdbox, and cannot by itself satisfy the 150-partition release gate.

sources.title: EBU Tech 3253 Sound Quality Assessment Material
sources.terms: R&D tool; no commercial use other than as an R&D tool
sources.ground_truth_basis: EBU identifies the package as FLAC lossless audio test sequences from Tech 3253. The handbook documents original recording and Compact Disc sources and includes material selected for bit-rate-reduction assessment.
sources.partition_basis: One official SQAM track per source case; recording-session/reference dependencies must be retained as partition-group metadata and never split across fitting and evaluation.
sources.limitations: The package contains 70 tracks but some tracks share recording sessions or Compact Disc sources. It is suitable for a frozen development transfer check, not an independent 150-partition Tier A release corpus. Terms prohibit distribution with the product.

artifact.checksum_basis: Two independent HTTPS downloads returned the same provider byte count, multipart ETag, MD5, SHA-256, and byte-for-byte content; the provider publishes no cryptographic checksum.
